content.short: Bucket Protocol is a decentralized CDP platform on Sui for minting the $BUCK stablecoin with high capital efficiency.
content.description:
Bucket Protocol is a Collateralized Debt Position (CDP) protocol built on the Sui network, designed to enhance capital efficiency through its USD-pegged stablecoin, $BUCK. Users can mint $BUCK by depositing various assets as collateral, including SUI, BTC, ETH, and liquid staking tokens. The protocol stands out by offering fixed interest rates and a minimum collateralization ratio as low as 110%, allowing users to maximize their borrowing power while maintaining predictable costs.

The ecosystem includes the Bucket Tank, a stability pool where depositors earn liquidated collateral as rewards, and a Peg Stability Module for 1:1 swaps with other stablecoins. By providing a robust lending infrastructure, Bucket Protocol serves as a foundational layer for DeFi on Sui, enabling users to leverage their assets without selling them.
